english.title: Drivers hours - permit driver to exceed 9 hours daily driving period
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in excess of nine hours daily driving period in contravention of Article 6(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit the driver of a motor vehicle to drive in excess of 9 hours daily driving period

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exceptions for the period from 1st November 2021 ending with 22nd January 2022: see regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 4) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1207) which permits drivers engaged in domestic goods transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 6 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 3, where daily driving time may be extended to at most 10 hours, not more than four times a week. Temporary exceptions for the period from 4th October 2021 ending with 31st October 2021: see regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 3) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1106) which permits drivers engaged in domestic goods transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 6 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 3, where daily driving time may be extended to at most 10 hours, not more than four times a week.
For the period from 9th August 2021 and ending with 3rd October 2021 see regulation 3 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No.2) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/921), where the daily driving time may be extended to at most 11 hours not more than twice during the week provided one of the requirements in regulation 2 applies.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) See also associated offence wording H2626.
